cues: Look at triangle P Q S.
The sixty degrees at Q is an exterior angle, so the angle inside at Q is one twenty.
Two equal angles: the triangle is isosceles, and Q S equals P Q, forty metres.
In the right triangle at the foot, the height is forty sin sixty: twenty root three, about thirty four point six metres.
text: Look at triangle P Q S. The sixty degrees at Q is an exterior angle, so the angle inside at Q is one twenty. That leaves thirty at S. Two equal angles: the triangle is isosceles, and Q S equals P Q, forty metres. In the right triangle at the foot, the height is forty sin sixty: twenty root three, about thirty four point six metres.
